question: How do I create an account?
answer: Click Sign Up and fill in your name email and password.

question: How do I change my password?
answer: Go to Settings and select Change Password.

question: What should I do if I forget my password?
answer: Click Forgot Password on the login page and follow the instructions sent to your email.

question: How can I update my email address?
answer: Open your account settings and edit your email address.

question: How do I update my profile information?
answer: Go to your profile page and click Edit Profile.

question: How do I delete my account?
answer: Open Settings and select Delete Account if the option is available.

question: How do I log out?
answer: Click your profile icon and select Log Out.

question: Why can't I log in?
answer: Check your email and password and make sure your internet connection is working.

question: How do I contact customer support?
answer: Email support@example.com or use the live chat feature.

question: What are your support hours?
answer: Our support team is available Monday through Friday during business hours.

question: How long does it take to receive a response from support?
answer: We typically respond within one business day.

question: How can I track my order?
answer: Open your Orders page and select the order you want to track.

question: How do I cancel an order?
answer: Visit your Orders page and select Cancel Order if cancellation is still available.

question: Can I change my shipping address?
answer: Contact support as soon as possible if your order has not shipped.

question: How long does delivery take?
answer: Delivery usually takes three to seven business days depending on your location.

question: What payment methods do you accept?
answer: We accept major credit cards and PayPal.

question: Why was my payment declined?
answer: Check your payment details and available balance or contact your bank.

question: How can I get a refund?
answer: Contact customer support with your order number and refund request.

question: How long do refunds take?
answer: Refund processing times depend on your payment provider and bank.

question: Where can I find my receipt?
answer: Open your order history and select the order to view its receipt.

question: How do I cancel my subscription?
answer: Go to Settings > Billing and click Cancel Subscription.

question: How can I upgrade my subscription?
answer: Open your Billing page and select an available upgrade plan.

question: How do I downgrade my subscription?
answer: Go to Billing and choose a lower subscription plan.

question: When will my subscription renew?
answer: Check your Billing page for your next renewal date.

question: What happens when my subscription expires?
answer: You may lose access to paid features until you renew your subscription.

question: Can I change my subscription payment method?
answer: Open Billing and update your saved payment method.

question: Is there a free plan?
answer: Check the Pricing page for available free plans and their limitations.

question: How do I reset my account settings?
answer: Open Settings and select the preferences you want to change.

question: How do I enable notifications?
answer: Go to Settings > Notifications and turn on your preferred alerts.
